verdict.rationale: Salv's own AI-Powered Insights feature takes on one narrow task: it adjudicates sanctions name matches and explains its reasoning. It is explicitly informational only and never closes an alert or makes a decision, so it is not a general assistant users can hand tasks to. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant (chat or agent), the ability to delegate tasks beyond name-match adjudication, AI-executed actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
